description: This file defines classes and functions related to file system operations, including file handling, directory management, and partition information within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, and provides interfaces for file creation, opening, reading, writing, and directory traversal.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, and attribute management, supporting both Windows and POSIX platforms.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Provides directory traversal and management functionalities, including creation, existence check, and recursive deletion.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Encapsulates information about disk partitions, including size, free space, and mount point details.

methods.name: ParsePathInfo
methods.description: Parses a string containing a path and permission info separated by '|', extracting the path and permission bits.

methods.name: File::Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a file path string, ensuring consistent formatting.

methods.name: File::LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file metadata such as size, timestamps, and attributes from the filesystem.

methods.name: Directory::Create
methods.description: Creates the directory at the specified path.

methods.name: Directory::CreatePath
methods.description: Creates the directory and any necessary parent directories.

methods.name: Partition::LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size, free space, and other details from the system.
